overview: One item inside an expanded row, linked to the others by a timeline. It has no action.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.text: Set `position` on each item: `first`, `middle` and `last` draw the line between the icons; `standalone` is a single item with no line.

rules: Use child items only inside a Transaction List Expandable.
Set `position` from the index of the item: first, middle, last, or standalone when it is alone.
Don’t attach click handlers to a Child Read Only; use Child Action for items that open details.
Keep the order of the items meaningful: it is the reading order.
Pass amounts formatted and without a sign; `amount.type` adds the sign and the color.
